Offered: $1,225,000“A quick note on how I like to negotiate: I respond to reasons and to movement, and I genuinely want us both to leave this conversation better off. Here is my honest reading of where we are and what would actually close this well for both of us. We are near the end of the road, so let me drop every pretense and speak plainly. The number I have on the table is the number at which I am ready to close right now - not an anchor, not a posture, the actual price. If we cannot land this in the next round or two, the outcome is fixed and mutually pointless: I keep my money and buy elsewhere or not at all, you keep an unsold product, and the entire surplus this trade could have created is gone. Nobody looks back on that outcome as a win. Weigh your alternatives honestly, the way I am weighing mine. Another round of holding firm buys you, at best, a few points of price - against the real and growing risk of losing the whole deal to a timeout or a walkaway. That is a reckless trade for either of us at this stage. My offer leaves you genuine positive value today, guaranteed, versus a gamble on nothing. I am not asking you to love the number; I am asking you to compare it against zero, because those are the two futures actually available. Accept my current offer, or meet it so nearly that the difference is not worth one more exchange - either way we both get paid and this ends the way good negotiations should: with both sides better off than they started. I am ready to close the moment you are. Let us not lose this deal over the last handful of points. I will close with this thought: the best outcomes here happen when both sides move early and generously. There is real value on this table for both of us - let us claim it together while the window is wide open.”
